Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Retransmission de manches de la Coupe du monde d'escalade. Organisée par l'IFSC depuis 1989, cette compétition annuelle se déroule à travers plusieurs étapes partout dans le monde. Trois catégories composent cette discipline : escalade de vitesse, de bloc, et de difficulté. Chacune d'entre elles donne un vainqueur dans sa catégorie. Il existe également un titre combiné pour les athlètes engagés dans deux catégories différentes.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Clap de fin pour la saison de difficulté à Santiago, au Chili. Chez les hommes, le Japonais Neo Suzuki, l'Espagnol Alberto Ginés Lopez et l'Indonésien Putra Tri Ramadani devraient se disputer la victoire. Côté féminin, la Slovène Janja Garnbret et l'Américaine Annie Sanders, qui ont remporté à elles deux toutes les manches cette saison, devraient à nouveau en découdre pour l'or.

programme.title: Curling : Championnats d'Europe
programme.desc: Suivez les Championnats d'Europe de curling, une compétition annuelle. Depuis 2005 les championnats féminin et masculin se tiennent ensemble. La première édition s'est déroulée en Bulgarie en 2004.

programme.title: Curling : Championnats d'Europe
programme.desc: Suivez les Championnats d'Europe de curling, une compétition annuelle. Depuis 2005 les championnats féminin et masculin se tiennent ensemble. La première édition s'est déroulée en Bulgarie en 2004.

programme.title: Tour de Lombardie
programme.desc: La 120e édition du Tour de Lombardie s'annonce historique en raison d'un grand bouleversement : l'absence du quintuple vainqueur sortant Tadej Pogacar. Qui lui succédera ?

programme.title: Tennis : Tournoi ATP de Bâle
programme.desc: L'Américain Ben Shelton, le Canadien Félix Auger-Aliassime, le Français Arthur Fils et l'Américain Taylor Fritz sont les quatre premières têtes de série de l'édition 2026 du Swiss Indoor Basel. Les retrouvera-t-on face à face en demi-finales ? A moins que le tenant du titre, le Brésilien Joao Fonseca se soit hissé dans le dernier carré ou encore le jeune Espagnol Rafael Jodar.

programme.title: ATP 500 Vienne
programme.desc: Retransmission d'un match de tennis du tournoi ATP de Vienne en Autriche. Ce tournoi, qui a une longue tradition étant présent depuis 1974, fait partie de la catégorie 500 dans le circuit ATP et se joue sur surface dure en intérieur.

programme.title: Tennis : Tournoi ATP de Bâle
programme.desc: Retransmission d'un match de tennis du tournoi ATP de Bâle, en Suisse. Ce tournoi, officiellement appelé Swiss Indoors Basel, a une longue tradition puisqu'étant présent depuis 1970. Il fait partie de la catégorie 500 sur le circuit ATP et se joue sur surface dure en intérieur. Bâle est aussi la ville natale de Roger Federer, où il a gagné dix fois, et joué autre cinq finales.

programme.title: Cyclo-cross : X2O Badkamers Trofee
programme.desc: Suivez les courses du X2O Badkamers Trofee, une compétition de cyclo-cross qui se déroule en Belgique. Le X2O Badkamers Trofee consiste en huit manches disputées sur toute la saison.

programme.title: Cyclo-cross : X2O Badkamers Trofee
programme.desc: Suivez les courses du X2O Badkamers Trofee, une compétition de cyclo-cross qui se déroule en Belgique. Le X2O Badkamers Trofee consiste en huit manches disputées sur toute la saison.

programme.title: Equitation : Global Champions Tour
programme.desc: Diffusion d'étapes du Global Champions Tour, une compétition internationale de saut d'obstacles réservée aux trente meilleurs cavaliers du classement mondial. La crème du hippisme se réunit lors de ces compétitions de saut d'obstacles qui se déroulent sur les plus réputés terrains de concours hippiques au monde. Créé en 2005, le Global Champions Tour a intégré la FEI sous forme de compétition officielle depuis 2008.

programme.title: Marathon de New York
programme.desc: Cette édition 2026 est historique puisqu'elle célèbre le 50e anniversaire du tracé emblématique du Marathon de New York qui relie les cinq districts de la ville.

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Cyclisme : Paris-Roubaix
programme.desc: 123e édition de Paris-Roubaix, surnommé "l'enfer du Nord", qui inclut 30 secteurs pavés pour une distance totale de 258,3 km. Le vainqueur succédera au palmarès au Néerlandais Mathieu Van der Poel, lauréat des trois dernières éditions. L'édition 2026 proposera un nouvel enchaînement des premières difficultés, ainsi qu'un secteur pavé en montée. Le Slovène Tadej Pogacar n'a pas caché que Paris-Roubaix était l'un de ses principaux objectifs de la saison.

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way
